text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, as I passed by the dance studio—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: —And that's the finish!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, Trainer-san! What a coincidence. 
Were ya watchin' me dance?"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
In that case, could you share your 
impressions with me? I'd like to use them 
as reference to improve.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Lucky Lilac tells me this with such 
enthusiasm. However, from what I've 
observed—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her dancing showed meticulous attention 
right down to her fingertips, flawless in 
both choreography and sense of rhythm 
without a single opening.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so? I'm honored by your praise.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Well. Just as you said, Trainer, I feel 
confident that I'm dancing properly. If 
this were a test, I'd probably pass.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: —But, I feel like... it just stops there.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"What I'm aiming for is a dance befitting 
a true star to perform."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"High technical skill is a given. On top 
of that, it's gotta be a captivating dance 
that'll keep eyes glued and make hearts 
flutter."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
That dance just now was merely technically 
proficient; it's far from being worthy of 
the spotlight.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Whatever it is that my dance is 
missing... I can't figure it out, and it's 
giving me a real hard time..."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, what do you reckon is missin' 
from my dance?
choice_data_list: That passion is second to none!
Your passion is second to none!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, what do you reckon is missin' 
from my dance?
choice_data_list: That passion is second to none!
Your passion is second to none!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Dynamic... Now that you mention it, 
perhaps I was being a bit too 
well-behaved.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Flowing elegance combined with raw, 
untamed dynamism. A fusion of two opposing 
elements... I think I'm starting to see 
it!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Alright, now that that's settled, shall we 
go meet her?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Dynamism...? Hmm, I wonder if Boo can 
teach you that?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's not like I'm asking you to 
teach a class or anything.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I simply just want to watch you up close, 
Blast-san, as you express your brightness 
and vitality with your whole being.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I don't really get it, but if I can 
help you, Lala, I'm super happy!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! What should we do, what should we do! 
I'm with Lala! I can't stop being excited!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Ah, this is it. Such dynamic emotional 
expression using her whole body! That's an 
expressive power I just don't have.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Askinn' Blast-san really was the right 
call! All right, I'm gonna soak up 
everythin' I can!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Learning dynamic emotional expression from 
Blast Onepiece greatly enhanced the charm 
and power of Lucky Lilac's dancing.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Energy... Indeed, that is an element that 
tends to be lacking when one focuses too 
much on gracefulness."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Still, the thing that moves people's 
hearts is always passion.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
If ya wanna learn about passion, it's 
gotta be that girl—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —I see, so that's why she came to me...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Kiseki-san pours her soul into her 
creations with constant passion, making 
her the perfect person to learn about 
fervor from.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I-It's a little embarrassing, but... I 
want to answer Lala-chan's earnest 
feelings. No, please let me answer them!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Facing hardships alongside your friends, 
that's the ultimate classic trope!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's head to a manga cafe now! 
If you want to learn about passion, 
reading the classics of the past is the 
best way!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Learning passion from Kiseki, Lucky 
Lilac's dance began to truly move people's 
hearts.
